title: Unit measurement history
responsibility: Displays recorded source, build-output and timing changes for a selected unit.

inputs.name: HarnessGrowth.index
inputs.description: Required repository measurements, unit choices, revisions and benchmark profiles used to build the history.

inputs.name: HarnessGrowth.client
inputs.description: Required client used to read recorded explanations for revisions where source or emitted measurements changed. Those asynchronous reads have no local failure handler.

inputs.name: HarnessGrowth.unit
inputs.description: Required selected unit identifier or null. Null selects the first indexed unit, or an empty identifier when there are no units.

inputs.name: HarnessGrowth.onunit
inputs.description: Required callback receiving the unit chosen in the selector.

inputs.name: HarnessGrowth.oncompare
inputs.description: Optional callback for opening before-and-after evidence at a changed commit. Defaults to doing nothing.

outputs.name: HarnessGrowth
outputs.description: Source size, complexity and dependency history, recorded explanations, build-target size history and timings grouped by compatible profile. Missing measurements stay unavailable. Uses the selected unit or the first indexed unit and fetches revision explanations for changed rows.
